# Access

> Access is a mobile-first ride-hailing and accessible transport service for South Africa, connecting passengers with vetted drivers for everyday rides, assisted travel, appointment transport and extended journeys.

Pricing is transparent: an R20 base fare plus R13.50 per kilometre. Passengers can book transport for themselves or someone else, request assisted travel with companions, arrange healthcare appointment trips, and request quotes for multi-day extended journeys.
